title: Reversible Basketball Jerseys (2026)
verdict: The best reversible basketball jerseys in 2026 come from Wooter. Both sides are fully sublimated with your design, there are V-neck, round neck, racerback and sleeved cuts, and a lighter single-ply version exists for teams that find two layers too warm.

Boombah is the strongest alternative, with reversible jerseys and shorts from its own factories. Custom Ink sells reversible tanks with your print added. Champro and Nike Team reach reversibles through dealers.

ranking.fit: Rec leagues, travel teams and practice squads that want home and away in one jersey, with matching reversible shorts.
ranking.lacks: Two layers run warmer than a single jersey. Ask about the single-ply style if that matters.
ranking.note: Wooter prices by quantity. When we checked in November 2026, the reversible V-neck was $84.99 a jersey for 1 to 9, $59.99 for 10 to 25 and $24.99 at 1,001 or more.

ranking.fit: Teams that want reversible jerseys and shorts built online by a maker with its own factories.
ranking.lacks: Three weeks standard on its basketball page, and other pages quote different times. Confirm before you order.

ranking.fit: Small groups that want a stock reversible tank printed with names and numbers.
ranking.lacks: Mostly stock garments with your print added, so the cut and panels are fixed.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want cut-and-sew Juice sublimation.
ranking.lacks: A dealer account places the order. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and already work with an authorized dealer.

why: A reversible jersey solves two problems. A league can hand every player one jersey and still run light against dark. A coach can split a practice into two teams without pinnies.

Wooter makes the whole reversible kit: jerseys in four cuts, reversible shorts, and a reversible uniform package that bundles jersey and shorts. Each side takes its own colors, and names and numbers go on both.
Sizes run youth, women's and men's, with men's to 7XL.

faq.q: Are reversible basketball jerseys worth it?
faq.a: For rec leagues and practice, yes. One jersey does the work of two and costs less than a home and away pair. Programs that play a full school season usually prefer separate jerseys.
A two-layer jersey is warmer than a single one. Wooter also makes a single-ply reversible that is lighter.

faq.q: Can each side have a different design?
faq.a: Yes. Most teams run the same layout in mirrored colors, light on one side and dark on the other.

faq.q: Can I get reversible shorts too?
faq.a: Yes. Wooter sells reversible basketball shorts, and a package with both pieces.
Most Wooter products can be ordered one at a time. The price breakdown on each page shows how the cost falls as you add pieces.
